item.title: California farmer arrested on suspicion of murder in wife's death in Arizona
item.description: Authorities say a prominent farmer has been arrested on suspicion of murder in the shooting death of his estranged wife.

item.title: Second-story Richmond Public Storage Facility collapses in fire
item.description: The fire broke out during the peak of Tuesday night's storm. Richmond Fire Chief Aaron Osorio says the strong winds contributed to the fire spreading.

item.title: Power restored to over 20K PG&E customers in Saratoga after substation fire
item.description: A fire at a substation in Saratoga is under investigation after starting and self-extinguishing Wednesday morning. The fire knocked out power to tens of thousands of customers, including homes and businesses near downtown Saratoga.

item.title: NORAD continues decades-long tradition of tracking Santa's trip around the world
item.description: Norad tracks Santa Claus' flight around the world on Christmas Eve.

item.title: Mayor Lurie calls for PG&E rate cuts after holiday outages as SF leaders demand answers
item.description: In the fallout from PG&E's citywide holiday weekend outages, San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie is calling on the utility to lower its rates, joining a growing chorus of city and state leaders who say frustration with the company is nothing new.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Another round of strong storms to hit Christmas evening
item.description: We are expecting another round of severe Level 3 storms this evening between 4 p.m. and 9 p.m., which will feature heavy rain and strong, damaging winds.

item.title: TIMELINE: More strong storms to bring heavy rain, damaging winds through Christmas
item.description: Our next round of storms arrives between 4 p.m. and 9 p.m. Christmas evening, which will feature heavy rain and strong, damaging winds. ABC7 meteorologist Drew Tuma has a timeline.

item.title: President Trump says US launched strike on ISIS terrorists in Nigeria
item.description: President Trump said in a post on his social media platform Thursday that he launched a "powerful and deadly strike" on ISIS terrorists in Nigeria, whom he claimed have been "targeting and viciously killing, primarily, innocent Christians."

item.title: New storm hitting waterlogged Southern California could bring mudslides and high surf
item.description: California, soaked from days of relentless rain and recovering from mudslides in mountain towns, was hit with another powerful storm Christmas Day that led to evacuation warnings and high surf advisories.

item.title: Officers shoot, kill armed man during Christmas Eve DUI traffic stop in Brentwood: police
item.description: A man in his 40s was shot and killed by officers in Brentwood on Christmas Eve night after he allegedly grabbed a loaded rifle during a DUI stop, according to police.
